learning_goal: Understand how Q, K, and V are transformed into attention scores, normalized attention weights, and the final weighted output, and understand why scaling by sqrt(d_k) is used.

concept.summary: Scaled dot-product attention compares each query with each key using a dot product, scales the scores, converts them into normalized weights with softmax, then uses those weights to combine the value vectors.
concept.why_it_matters: It is the core mechanism that lets a Transformer decide which pieces of information are most relevant to each token.

symbols.name: Query matrix
symbols.meaning: Represents what each token is looking for.

symbols.name: Key matrix
symbols.meaning: Represents what each token offers for matching.

symbols.name: Value matrix
symbols.meaning: Contains the information that will be combined after attention weights are computed.

symbols.name: Key dimension
symbols.meaning: Dimensionality of the key/query vectors; used in the scaling factor sqrt(d_k).

equations.meaning: Compute query-key similarity, scale it, normalize it with softmax, then form a weighted sum of values.

mechanism_steps.name: Similarity scores
mechanism_steps.description: Compute QK^T to measure how strongly each query matches each key.

mechanism_steps.name: Scaling
mechanism_steps.description: Divide the scores by sqrt(d_k) so that large dot products do not make the softmax distribution excessively sharp.

mechanism_steps.name: Normalization
mechanism_steps.description: Apply softmax row-wise so each row becomes a probability-like distribution that sums to 1.

mechanism_steps.name: Weighted output
mechanism_steps.description: Multiply the attention weights by V to combine value vectors according to the learned relevance.

assumptions: Use small matrices for the educational demonstration.
limitations: A small toy example demonstrates the mechanism but does not reproduce the full Transformer architecture or the paper's experimental results.
common_misunderstandings: Q, K, and V are not probabilities themselves.
The scaling factor changes the score magnitudes before softmax; it is not an extra attention head.

source_grounding.claim: Scaled dot-product attention computes dot products between queries and keys, divides by sqrt(d_k), applies softmax, and uses the result to weight the values.
